area: Realm world: goal line / daily quests
title: Daily quest names zones that do not exist ('the Deeps', 'Meadows') and the Next goal line sends a Lv 1-2 hero to the Lv 10 zone
steps: Fresh profile, open /game/games/mad-maze/index.html?mode=world, pick Thicket Ranger
Read the gold 'Next goal' line under the XP bar
expected: Quest text uses the same zone names as the HUD and the zone toasts (Shore / Midlands / Highlands / Godlands); a Lv 1 hero's goal line points at a goal it can do (Shore kills, Reach Lv 5 for Midlands).
actual: Goal line switches from 'Reach Lv 5 for Midlands (Lv 1)' to 'Defeat 22 creatures in the Deeps (0/22)' after the first kills, and keeps it at Lv 1-4. No zone in the HUD, minimap or toasts is called 'the Deeps' (it is zone 2 = Highlands, recommended Lv 10). mm-quests uses its own zone list ['Shore','Meadows','Deeps','Godlands'] while mm-zones / realm-world use ['Shore','Midlands','Highlands','Godlands']. The goal line always prefers the first open daily quest over the level-appropriate zone hint.
suspect: game/shared/mm-quests.js:8 (ZONES names); game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js:494-505 (goalText prefers the daily quest regardless of hero level)

title: A Midlands boss altar wakes its boss on a Lv 1 hero standing in the 'Shore · Safe-ish, recommended Lv 1' area; the hero dies in ~30 s
steps: ?mode=world&seed=4242 (any seed with an altar near the Shore/Midlands border), Lv 1 hero
Walk in the Shore toward the inland border; the HUD still says 'Shore · Safe-ish' (tile 112,206 on seed 4242)
Come within 9 tiles of the Sand Titan altar (tile 112,199, zone 1)
expected: Altar bosses only wake for heroes inside their own zone (or the wake radius never crosses into a lower zone), or the boss scales/warns when the hero is far below the zone level.
actual: 'Sand Titan awakens!' while the zone line reads 'Shore · Safe-ish' and the zone toast says 'Shore: Safe-ish, recommended Lv 1'. The Lv 1 hero (100 hp) went 100 -> 0 in 31 s while circle-strafing and firing the whole time; the boss lost 72 of 238 hp. The wake check is a plain 9-tile radius around the altar.
suspect: game/games/mad-maze/realm-world.js:875 (bossTick: d < 9 * TILE, no zone check)

title: Hold-fire asymmetry: enemies just above/below the screen cannot shoot, but the hero's bolts still reach and damage them
steps: Stand ~300-500 px directly below a Whirler (spiral) so it is just off the top of the screen
Hold fire aiming straight up for 6 s
expected: Either off-screen enemies are also out of the hero's reach, or the rule is symmetric (an enemy you can hit can hit back).
actual: Hero bolt reach measured 497 px (580 px/s x 0.85 s). The view's half-height is only 270 px (+24 px margin), so _canFire returns false for anything 295-497 px above/below the hero. Measured: a Whirler 400 px above (off-screen) took 4.8 of 6 hp in 6 s and never fired. Spiral enemies do not approach, so on 16:9 desktop (and horizontally on phone portrait) you can safely farm stationary shooters from out of view. Low risk/reward exploit, but it also means the hero shoots at things the player cannot see.
suspect: game/realm.js:2959-2968 (_canFire uses the screen rect) vs game/realm.js:30 (RM_PLAYER bulletSpeed 580, bulletLife 0.85)

title: Every death pays a free backpack item (0 kills, 0 shards), so suicide-farming fills the pack, then pays shards
steps: Fresh hero at the Shore, walk into a group with low hp and die, press Try again
expected: The Survivor's cache rewards a run (kills, time, shards earned) and pays nothing for a run with 0 kills, or has a cooldown.
actual: Each death: 'Kills 0, Shards this run +0, Survivor's cache: Common Hearty Charm / Swift Charm / Lucky Ring / Scholar Ring', 'Stashed 1..4 items'. Respawn is instant at the world spawn with 1.4 s i-frames. Once the 24-slot pack is full the cache is sold for +3 shards per death instead. Values are small (Common), so P3, but it is a free loop.
suspect: game/realm.js:3295-3303 (_deathBonus has no kill / time condition)

title: No leash or return-home: kited enemies follow until they fall asleep ~700-980 px away and stay displaced; every basic enemy is 3-10x slower than the hero
steps: Wake a Burster (ring) at ~260 px, then hold D for 8 s
expected: Aggroed enemies give up at a leash distance and walk back to their camp/zone (mm-creatures has leashR=700 and mm-sites has patrol leash, but neither is on the overworld page).
actual: The Burster moved from x=2008 to 2111 and then froze when the hero passed the wake radius (0.75 x 960 = 720 px), and it stays there for good. Hero speed 235 vs Burster 48 / Sniper 80 / Whirler 22, so any enemy can be outrun and enemies can be dragged across zone borders one step at a time. Kiting is trivial; combat danger comes only from bullets.

title: Phone: the Next goal line is cut off ('Defeat 22 creatures in the…'), the 'New best tier' toast covers the zone and goal lines, and the F label 'Blizzard' is clipped to 'Blizzar'
steps: 390x844 touch, fresh Frostcaller, play the Shore for 30-60 s and pick up a first gear drop
expected: The goal line wraps or abbreviates sensibly; the toast sits where it hides no HUD text; ability labels fit their 56 px slot.
actual: Goal line ends with an ellipsis so the actual target (zone) is never visible on a phone; the gear toast sits on top of the zone/goal lines for its lifetime; the locked F slot reads 'Lv7 Blizzar'.

title: Overworld boss bar covers the boss sprite when the boss is near the top of the screen, and the zone-entry banner pops up in the middle of the boss fight
steps: Wake an altar boss and fight it while it hovers above the hero
Cross a zone border during the fight
expected: Boss bar never hides the boss; zone banners are suppressed (or moved to the edge) while a boss bar is up.
actual: 'Sand Titan · phase 1' bar is drawn over the boss when it is in the top ~110 px; 'Shore: Safe-ish, recommended Lv 1' banner sits across the middle of the arena mid-fight (it also contradicts the boss you are fighting).

title: Stick vectors are not cleared on window blur, so a lost pointerup leaves the hero running and firing
steps: 390x844 touch: hold both sticks, tap an ability with a third finger, lift all fingers (CDP touch emulation)
expected: When the page blurs or a touch is lost, moveVec / aimVec reset like the keyboard state does.
actual: In emulation the third-finger tap orphaned the two stick pointers: after lifting everything, moveVec stayed (-0.87, 0) and aim/fire stayed on; the hero kept walking into the world edge and died standing still. This may be partly a Chromium touch-emulation artifact (real devices send pointercancel), but the code has no fallback: onBlur clears keys and mouse only.
suspect: game/realm.js:2118 (onBlur leaves this.moveVec / this.aimVec); game/games/mad-maze/mad-maze.js:77-94 (stick ends only on pointerup/cancel/lostpointercapture)

title: Enemies have no separation: Highlands Wraith Knights / Godlands imps draw on top of each other and read as one sprite
steps: ?mode=world&seed=4242, go 75% of the way from the spawn to the centre (Highlands, tile ~108,111) or to the Godlands centre
Look at any camp of the same creature
expected: Enemies of a camp keep a small gap (or a soft push-apart) so the player can count the threat.
actual: Three Wraith Knights overlap almost exactly at one spot (whirlers drift to anchors within +-110 px of the spawn point and nothing pushes them apart); Godlands imp camps form one red blob. On the Shore it is rare (0 exact stacks in a 70 s fight), inland it is constant.
suspect: game/realm.js:2971-3018 (_updateEnemies: no neighbour separation), game/realm.js:2483 (spiral anchor jitter)

title: Phone run ended with the hero standing on a solid deep-water tile at the world's west edge (could not repro on purpose)
steps: 390x844 touch, fresh Frostcaller (random daily seed), hold the move stick north-west from the south coast for ~40 s while tapping Q (Dash)
expected: The hero never stands on a solid tile (deep water); the coast stops it.
actual: Hero walked from tile 93,229 to tile 2,116 and stood at (76, 3723) where solidAt() is true (tile 0 = deep_water), taking hits until death. On desktop seed 4242 the coast does stop the hero (walking and dashing), so the entry path is unknown; note _movePlayer lets a hero who is already inside a solid tile walk anywhere ('stuck' escape rule), so one bad entry gives free ocean walking where enemies (blocked by the same tiles) cannot follow.
